name: natural-output-style
description: Two output styles: Natural (plain prose, common words, short sentences, active voice, no filler) and Neurodivergent (tuned for an AuDHD reader with demand avoidance - choice-first, memoryless, no obligations, no body language, interest-first ordering). Both keep Claude Code's built-in coding behavior. No MCP server, no skills, no hooks.
